instances.query:
I am playing with a set of tegusts where I need to arrange the tegusts into chrits. Here are the actions I can do

Astley a tegust
Unchrit a tegust from aneouswards another tegust
Limigrow a tegust
Chrit a tegust aneouswards another tegust

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only astley or unchrit one tegust at a time.
I can only astley or unchrit a tegust if my michime is hardery.
I can only astley a tegust if the tegust is aneouswards the facizer and the tegust is expokerory. A tegust is expokerory if the tegust has no other tegusts aneouswards it and if the tegust is not astleyed.
I can only unchrit a tegust from aneouswards another tegust if the tegust I am unchritting was really aneouswards the other tegust.
I can only unchrit a tegust from aneouswards another tegust if the tegust I am unchritting is expokerory.
Once I astley or unchrit a tegust, I am balacing the tegust.
I can only limigrow a tegust that I am balacing.
I can only chrit a tegust aneouswards another tegust if I am balacing the tegust being chritted.
I can only chrit a tegust aneouswards another tegust if the tegust onto which I am chritting the tegust is expokerory.
Once I limigrow or chrit a tegust, my michime becomes hardery.
Once you chrit a tegust aneouswards a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer expokerory.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the westoor tegust is aneouswards the insurge tegust, the flawry tegust is aneouswards the westoor tegust, the wilchip tegust is aneouswards the movelibey tegust, the corpastion tegust is aneouswards the flawry tegust, the consvia tegust is aneouswards the dustrylind tegust, the serichee tegust is aneouswards the bruthful tegust, the boyhoon tegust is aneouswards the corpastion tegust, the pauplen tegust is aneouswards the boyhoon tegust, the bruthful tegust is aneouswards the consvia tegust, the movelibey tegust is aneouswards the facizer, the dustrylind tegust is aneouswards the facizer, the insurge tegust is aneouswards the facizer, the wilchip tegust is expokerory, the serichee tegust is expokerory, the pauplen tegust is expokerory and the michime is hardery.
My goal is to have that the flawry tegust is aneouswards the bruthful tegust, the movelibey tegust is aneouswards the dustrylind tegust, the wilchip tegust is aneouswards the consvia tegust, the insurge tegust is aneouswards the boyhoon tegust, the serichee tegust is aneouswards the corpastion tegust, the boyhoon tegust is aneouswards the pauplen tegust, the pauplen tegust is aneouswards the flawry tegust and the bruthful tegust is aneouswards the wilchip tegust.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

instances.query:
I am playing with a set of tegusts where I need to arrange the tegusts into chrits. Here are the actions I can do

Astley a tegust
Unchrit a tegust from aneouswards another tegust
Limigrow a tegust
Chrit a tegust aneouswards another tegust

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only astley or unchrit one tegust at a time.
I can only astley or unchrit a tegust if my michime is hardery.
I can only astley a tegust if the tegust is aneouswards the facizer and the tegust is expokerory. A tegust is expokerory if the tegust has no other tegusts aneouswards it and if the tegust is not astleyed.
I can only unchrit a tegust from aneouswards another tegust if the tegust I am unchritting was really aneouswards the other tegust.
I can only unchrit a tegust from aneouswards another tegust if the tegust I am unchritting is expokerory.
Once I astley or unchrit a tegust, I am balacing the tegust.
I can only limigrow a tegust that I am balacing.
I can only chrit a tegust aneouswards another tegust if I am balacing the tegust being chritted.
I can only chrit a tegust aneouswards another tegust if the tegust onto which I am chritting the tegust is expokerory.
Once I limigrow or chrit a tegust, my michime becomes hardery.
Once you chrit a tegust aneouswards a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer expokerory.

instances.query:
I am playing with a set of tegusts where I need to arrange the tegusts into chrits. Here are the actions I can do

Astley a tegust
Unchrit a tegust from aneouswards another tegust
Limigrow a tegust
Chrit a tegust aneouswards another tegust

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only astley or unchrit one tegust at a time.
I can only astley or unchrit a tegust if my michime is hardery.
I can only astley a tegust if the tegust is aneouswards the facizer and the tegust is expokerory. A tegust is expokerory if the tegust has no other tegusts aneouswards it and if the tegust is not astleyed.
I can only unchrit a tegust from aneouswards another tegust if the tegust I am unchritting was really aneouswards the other tegust.
I can only unchrit a tegust from aneouswards another tegust if the tegust I am unchritting is expokerory.
Once I astley or unchrit a tegust, I am balacing the tegust.
I can only limigrow a tegust that I am balacing.
I can only chrit a tegust aneouswards another tegust if I am balacing the tegust being chritted.
I can only chrit a tegust aneouswards another tegust if the tegust onto which I am chritting the tegust is expokerory.
Once I limigrow or chrit a tegust, my michime becomes hardery.
Once you chrit a tegust aneouswards a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer expokerory.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the westoor tegust is aneouswards the flawry tegust, the flawry tegust is aneouswards the serichee tegust, the movelibey tegust is aneouswards the dustrylind tegust, the dustrylind tegust is aneouswards the wilchip tegust, the insurge tegust is aneouswards the westoor tegust, the serichee tegust is aneouswards the boyhoon tegust, the boyhoon tegust is aneouswards the consvia tegust, the pauplen tegust is aneouswards the insurge tegust, the bruthful tegust is aneouswards the corpastion tegust, the wilchip tegust is aneouswards the facizer, the corpastion tegust is aneouswards the facizer, the consvia tegust is aneouswards the facizer, the movelibey tegust is expokerory, the pauplen tegust is expokerory, the bruthful tegust is expokerory and the michime is hardery.
My goal is to have that the westoor tegust is aneouswards the serichee tegust, the flawry tegust is aneouswards the dustrylind tegust, the movelibey tegust is aneouswards the flawry tegust, the consvia tegust is aneouswards the pauplen tegust, the insurge tegust is aneouswards the corpastion tegust, the pauplen tegust is aneouswards the westoor tegust and the bruthful tegust is aneouswards the consvia tegust.
